instruction: Set the VLC recordings folder to be saved in the Videos directory

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires modifying VLC's recording folder to Videos directory. The evaluator uses the existing is_vlc_recordings_folder function to verify if 'input-record-path' in vlcrc is set to '/home/user/Videos'.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the complete instruction requirement: VLC recordings folder set to Videos directory
Getter (get_vlc_config) correctly extracts VLC config file (vlcrc) which contains recording path settings
Metric (is_vlc_recordings_folder) correctly searches for 'input-record-path' in vlcrc and compares value to expected path
Expected value '/home/user/Videos' is semantically correct for the Videos directory on Linux
No postconfig needed - VLC saves settings to vlcrc immediately upon configuration change
Edge cases properly handled: file not found, key not found, comments/empty lines skipped, exceptions caught
Data flow is correct: vlcrc file → extract input-record-path value → compare to /home/user/Videos
